summary: Limits notification drawer background polling to active progress notifications and improves tabbed Options discoverability. The browser no longer performs a standing unread-badge poll; it refreshes on drawer/action use and runs the deduplicated 3s poll only while a locked progress notification exists. Tabbed Options now keeps Theme and Language as separate tabs even when card/compact layouts merge the small-choice controls. Inline-safe: template/static JavaScript/docs/tests only; no migration.
highlights: Removes the standing 15s unread-badge notification poll.
Runs deduped 3s polling only while a locked progress notification exists.
Keeps Theme and Language as separate tabs in tabbed Options style.
Preserves the small-choice Theme/Language merge for card and compact Options layouts.
